action.body: Please supply your commercial invoice for DL-045 / OS-045 with the fields the appointed broker listed: seller, buyer, date/reference, description, quantity, unit value/currency/total and origin declaration. The broker must review it.
action.recipients: Fera Noll, Mavelle Export Studio shipping lead

later_events.body: Our issued synthetic [commercial invoice CI-045](attachments/commercial-invoice.pdf) is supplied for DL-045 / OS-045. It covers 12 woven pouches at GBP 8.00 each, GBP 96.00 total, made in the fictional origin jurisdiction Aster Reach. Please review the stated fields.
later_events.recipients: Ossmere Trade Desk, appointed customs broker; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
later_events.sender: Fera Noll, Mavelle Export Studio shipping lead

later_events.body: CI-045 is received and all fields requested for this document package are complete. The package can proceed to our processing queue. Customs clearance and charges remain undecided.
